threads.subject: New York Mets staff and front office

reports.text: Sources: The Mets are hiring Johnny Washington as a co-hitting coach. He had been the Braves minor league hitting coordinator.
Mets are hiring AJ Ellis as a strategy coordinator, as @WillSammon mentioned. Longtime Dodger and Kershaw confidant behind the plate, played for the Padres when Andy Green managed there.

Mariano Duncan will indeed be a member of Andy Green’s coaching staff next year, as @Joelsherman1 reported. Mets still hunting for a hitting coach. Have heard names reported in connection — Cubs’ Malle and Kevin Long — no longer in mix, as @NYPost_Mets and others have said
Source: The Mets have hired Mariano Duncan to join their major league coaching staff. He is expected to help in multiple areas with the position player group.
So Mets DFA Kyren Paris and Cristian Cairo, which I believe means they are back to exactly 40 on the 40-man. Will have to clear room for any additions, but they can figure that out later.
Orioles announce they’ve claimed LHP Philip Abner off waivers from the Mets.

The Mets have also claimed righty Pierson Ohl from the Rockies, according to a person familiar with the situation. Ohl was traded to the Rockies after being drafted and developed by, you guessed it, the Minnesota Twins.
